title: Element Appearing More Than 25% In Sorted Array
summary: Given an integer array sorted in non-decreasing order, identify and return the integer that appears more than 25% of the time.
statement: Given an integer array sorted in non-decreasing order, identify and return the integer that appears more than 25% of the time.
constraints: arr is sorted and one value appears more than 25%.
hints: In sorted order, a value over one quarter spans positions distance floor(n/4).
Scan i and compare arr[i] with arr[i+n//4].
The first equality identifies a qualifying repeated block.
Every block longer than n/4 contains such an indexed pair.
editorial: Every block longer than n/4 contains such an indexed pair.

tests.explanation: Six occupies four of nine positions, exceeding one quarter.
One occupies two of four positions.
